summary.en: The persistent frame of a data film: chapter label, the accent key, a progress rule with a tick per chapter, the source line and the legend.
summary.zh: 数据片的常驻框架：章节名、强调色图例、每章一刻度的进度线、数据来源行和图例。

fits: Data films whose numbers need their source and unit on screen all through.
notFor: Launch films (a frame of labels reads as a report); films with no data source.

intent.en: The source and the unit stay on screen, so every number in the film reads as checked.
intent.zh: 来源和单位一直在屏上，片里每个数字都显得经过核对。

content.en: Chapter label (≤ 24 / 10 字), the accent key (≤ 30 / 12 字), number of chapters, a source line (≤ 60 / 24 字), legend entries.
content.zh: 章节标签（≤ 24 字符 / 10 字），强调色图例（≤ 30 / 12 字），章节数，来源一行（≤ 60 / 24 字），图例项。

fits.zh: 数字需要全程标出来源与单位的数据片。

notFor.zh: 发布片（满屏标签像报告）；没有数据来源的片。

en: Keep it to the corners; the frame must never cover the squares.
zh: 只放在四角；框不能压住方块。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
